AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Clock provides deterministic on-device functions for alarms, timers, Focus sessions, countdowns, stopwatch controls and navigation. Operational rules: use startTimer for ordinary countdowns; use startFocus for work sessions; use createOneTimeAlarm only for a future ISO-8601 instant; use prepareNaturalLanguageCommand when the request is ambiguous or requires user review. Never claim an action succeeded unless the returned result confirms it. Destructive deletion and data reset are intentionally unavailable.
